property_summary: After deploying C, calling availableForFlashLoan on a token that has been minted to the contract returns true in the reference (baseToken is set) but false in the mutant (baseToken is not set, so flashFeeToken() returns address(0) causing flashFee and protocolFee to be calculated with wrong decimals, but the divergence is actually that baseToken getter returns different values).
change_summary: Remove the line that sets the baseToken state variable.
